verdict.notice: Some results are older than the design. Run nopekit check, then build the site again.
verdict.sentence: v0.2 is NOT ready. 15 of 26 required claims are unresolved: 3 failing (C6, C7, C10); 6 gaps (A1, A3, A4, C4, +2 more); 6 pending build (P1, P2, P3, P4, +2 more). 11 of 26 claims are checked on the current design. Pending build: 6 claims need a test on a built part (P1, P2, P3, P4, +2 more). No claim is checked on any built part.

basis.established: An existing tool gives the answer.
basis.model-only: A model wrote the logic. It has no outside source.
basis.sourced: The logic follows a cited outside source.
basis.undeclared: The evaluator does not say where its answers come from.

by.measurement: A measurement on a built part settles it.
by.none: Nothing settles it. It is accepted for now.

notices.build_failed: The last build failed. This page shows the build before it.
notices.disagree: The status and the evidence of this claim disagree. This is a defect in nopekit. Report it.
notices.invalidated: Some results are older than the design. Run nopekit check, then build the site again.
notices.no_intro: Add site/content/intro.md to describe the design.
notices.prose_stale: This text was written before the latest results. The data below shows the results now.
notices.prose_unstamped: This text has no stamp. It can be older than the results. The data below shows the results now.
notices.reads_all: This evaluator reads every value of the design.
notices.unmatched: No result on this page has this number.
notices.unmatched_note: A number with this mark is not in a result on this page.

assumed.hint: A person accepts this claim for now.

checked.hint: Every evaluator showed that it can fail, and each one passed on the current design.

errored.hint: An evaluator stopped with an error. A crash settles nothing.

failing.hint: An evaluator or a test on a built part failed the current design.

gap.hint: Nothing can settle this claim yet.

open.hint: An evaluator can settle this claim. It did not run on the current design.

pending_build.hint: Only a test on a built part can settle this claim.

skipped.hint: An evaluator did not run. A tool that it needs is missing.

stale.hint: The design changed after the result.

trace.amber_flips: This pass changes to a fail if an assumption is wrong by 10%.
trace.amber_holds: This pass stays a pass if an assumption is wrong by 10%.
trace.amber_legend: Amber: passes if the assumptions hold.
trace.amber_not_current: The assumption test for this pass is out of date.
trace.amber_unclear: The assumption test for this pass did not give an answer.
trace.amber_untraced: The assumptions under this pass are not tested yet.
trace.caption: Each line is one claim. It goes through the shared values that its evaluators read, in the order that the test found. It ends on its board.
trace.feeds_key: A thin line shows which shared values a group of choices changes.
trace.notice_traced: At round {round}, the model was built again with each choice changed by 10%. A thin line joins a group of choices to each shared value that moved.
trace.notice_traced_no_round: The model was built again with each choice changed by 10%. A thin line joins a group of choices to each shared value that moved.
trace.notice_untraced: The links from the choices are not measured yet. Each line starts at the values that its evaluators read.
trace.running: The links from the choices are being measured now.
trace.sets: This assumption sets choices that change these shared values.
trace.settles: This test on a built part settles the assumptions at these shared values.
trace.skipped: The test did not change {n} choices: {names}. The map cannot show what they change.
trace.skipped_one: The test did not change the choice {names}. The map cannot show what it changes.
trace.unmoved: The test did not see {n} shared values change: {names}. This does not show that no choice changes them.
trace.unmoved_one: The test did not see the shared value {names} change. This does not show that no choice changes it.
trace.unseen_line: The test did not see a change in the values that this claim reads.
trace.upstream_stop: The test puts this value before the values that this claim reads.
trace.zone_unmeasured: The test did not measure what these choices change.
trace.zones_summary: {n} choices in {z} groups. The bar shows where each number comes from.
